prompt: In a cinematic film still set within a humid botanical greenhouse, the scene captures a quiet moment of discovery among lush greenery. On the left, an elderly woman in a wide-brimmed straw hat stands beside a towering fern, her posture slightly hunched as she examines the fronds. In the center, a young boy in a bright yellow raincoat points excitedly toward a glass terrarium, his arm fully extended to draw attention to the specimen inside. Next to him, a small tabby cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, its tail wrapped neatly around its paws while it watches the boy with mild curiosity. To the right, a gardener in blue overalls kneels by a potting station, carefully handing a trowel to a teenager in a denim jacket who stands nearby with hands outstretched to receive the tool. Behind them, a large parrot with vibrant red feathers perches on a hanging vine, observing the group below with keen interest. The air is thick with mist, blurring the background slightly, yet the six distinct figures remain sharp and clear. There is no sunlight streaming through the roof, keeping the illumination soft and diffuse throughout the space. The interaction between the gardener and the teenager highlights a moment of teaching, while the boy’s gesture connects him visually to the enclosed plant life. The elderly woman’s position anchors the left side of the frame, balancing the composition against the active pair on the right. Every element, from the wet leaves to the muddy boots of the gardener, contributes to the immersive atmosphere of this enclosed garden world.
